Subject: SIG intake + quick call to align on evidence owners

Hi Marcus and Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to help with Pinegrove's security intake for our upcoming vendor review. We're consolidating SIG/CAIQ answers this week and would like a short sync to: (1) confirm which Redwood teams own specific CAIQ sections, (2) review any available artifacts (logs, architecture diagram), and (3) confirm timeline for sample evidence.

Suggested agenda (30 mins):
- Intro + scope (5m)
- CAIQ section owners (10m)
- Evidence handoff: logs, configs, SOC2 artifacts (10m)
- Next steps + deadlines (5m)

Are you available tomorrow (Mon 6/21) 10:00–10:30 PT or Tues 6/22 14:00–14:30 PT? If neither works, propose alternatives.

We attached a filled CSV of our intake mapping and the primary questions we want to triage.

Best,
Sarah Hatfield
Sr. Information Security Manager | Pinegrove Health

Thanks Marcus — I'm on for Tue 6/22.

Sarah: short answers up front to help you triage before the call:
- CAIQ sections: I'll take Data Protection (DP), Cryptography (CRY), and Key Management (KM).
- Hannah will own Logging (LO) and Monitoring (MO) evidence and SOC2 artifact handoff.
- We can provide an architecture diagram, KMS key rotation policy, and sanitized sample logs for the week of 6/29.

- For the CAIQ DP/KM sections, can you confirm whether Redwood uses a customer-specific KMS per account for Dedicated/Private, or a platform-managed KMS for Hosted? We need to document key isolation details.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Hatfield <sarah.hatfield@pinegrovehealth.com>, Dustin Evans <dustin.evans@pinegrovehealth.com>

Date: 2026-06-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pinegrove SIG intake — meeting notes & action items

Thanks everyone for the call — notes and action items below.

Meeting notes (Tue 6/22, 14:00 PT):
- Scope: Pinegrove will evaluate Redwood via SIG/CAIQ; primary focus on data protection, key management, logging, and SOC2 artifacts.
- Deployment modes: Pinegrove scoped both Hosted API and Dedicated; for Dedicated we confirm customer-specific KMS is available (customer key material can be hosted in a customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private setups). Hosted uses a platform-managed KMS by default; we'll document key isolation model in the CAIQ response.
- Evidence available: architecture diagram, KMS rotation policy, encryption in transit/at-rest descriptions, sanitized CSV log samples, SOC2 Type II report (redacted), and our evidence mapping spreadsheet.
- Log retention: Redwood retains application logs for 90 days by default; we can provide a 1-year archive on request (separate dataset export).

Action items & owners:
- Kimberly: Populate CAIQ DP/CRY/KM sections with detailed answers and attach KMS policy (due 2026-06-26). Attach: redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx
- Hannah: Provide sanitized CSV of sample logs (week of 6/8–6/14) and metadata about log schema (due 2026-06-29).
- Marcus: Draft CAIQ cover notes describing deployment modes & key isolation; coordinate SOC2 redacted artifact transfer via secure share (due 2026-06-25).
- Pinegrove (Sarah/Dustin): Share any compliance-specific templates or mandatory fields your audit team requires (due 2026-06-24).
- AuditOps: Confirm preferred transfer method for raw logs (SFTP/secure share) and any PII handling expectations (points of contact on file).

Attachments delivered during call: redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx, pinegrove-intake-agenda.pdf

Next steps: We will update the CAIQ draft in the Drive folder, then do a follow-up call if any high-risk gaps are identified.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-evidence-map-v1.xlsx
